# Semantic-layer metrics

Metric definitions from the dbt semantic layer (MetricFlow). These are the
canonical definitions — a query answering a metric question should reproduce
the definition below, not invent a variant (one metric, one definition).

## average_order_value

Label: Average Order Value
Type: ratio
Definition: Revenue divided by order count, both excluding cancelled orders.
Ratio: `revenue` / `order_count`

## emea_revenue_share

Label: EMEA Revenue Share
Type: ratio
Definition: Share of revenue from EMEA customers. Guest checkouts have no region and are excluded from the numerator but included in the denominator.
Ratio: `revenue` / `revenue`

## order_count

Label: Orders
Type: simple
Definition: Count of non-cancelled orders, excluding internal test accounts.
Filter: `[{'where_sql_template': "{{ Dimension('order__order_status') }} != 'cancelled'"}]`

## revenue

Label: Revenue
Type: simple
Definition: Gross order revenue in USD, excluding cancelled orders and internal test accounts. Verified against the NetSuite ledger for 2026-06 (0.02% variance). NOT net of refunds — use net_revenue for that.
Filter: `[{'where_sql_template': "{{ Dimension('order__order_status') }} != 'cancelled'"}]`

## revenue_growth_mom

Label: Revenue Growth MoM (%)
Type: derived
Definition: Month-over-month revenue growth, percent. Null for the first month in the series.
Formula: `(revenue - revenue_prev_month) * 100.0 / nullif(revenue_prev_month, 0)`

## revenue_mtd

Label: Revenue (Month to Date)
Type: cumulative
Definition: Revenue accumulated from the start of the calendar month.

## revenue_trailing_28d

Label: Revenue (Trailing 28 Days)
Type: cumulative
Definition: Rolling 28-day revenue. Requires the metricflow_time_spine model.
